Job Workers and User Tasks

TaktX separates job worker and user task processing into distinct topics. This separation enables independent scaling, monitoring, and tuning for each type of workload.

Job Worker Topics

Each job worker gets its own topic, allowing for dedicated processing and resource allocation. This is especially useful for high-throughput or specialized workers. Using the Kafka consumer group mechansim this also guarantuees that each job is only executed only once. 

User Task Topic

User tasks are passed to a separate topic, enabling dedicated monitoring and processing. This separation also makes it easier to implement custom user interfaces or integrations for human-in-the-loop scenarios. Currently there is no "tasklist" like application. User tasks must be handled using the TatkX client SDK.

Scaling and Monitoring

By isolating job worker and user task topics, TaktX allows you to scale each independently and monitor their performance separately, ensuring optimal resource usage and responsiveness.
